name: ProductGrid
description:
A responsive grid of product cards. Layout is delegated entirely to the
shared Grid primitive and the loading state is composed from the
shared Skeleton primitive inside the Card family — no raw
layout `<div>`, no per-component stylesheet, no inline style, and no
hardcoded colors. Appearance is driven by tokens + primitives only.

props.name: columns
props.description:
Responsive column count for the underlying Grid primitive.
Defaults to a responsive 1→2→3→4 progression across breakpoints.
